THEARCHITECT-THE_UNWRITTEN.title: The Watcher
THEARCHITECT-THE_UNWRITTEN.pages.INITIAL: Among relics of a forgotten climb, a familiar figure waits. The Watcher offers a lesson for the path ahead.
THEARCHITECT-THE_UNWRITTEN.pages.DONE.de: Carry the lesson, not the burden.
THEARCHITECT-THE_UNWRITTEN.talk.firstVis: I have walked these stairs before. What remains of that journey may yet serve yours.
THEARCHITECT-THE_UNWRITTEN.talk.ANY.0-0r: Preparation. Discipline. Transcendence. Consider what your journey still lacks.
The past is a patient teacher. Take one lesson with you.
